import { CommonModule, DatePipe, NgFor, NgIf } from '@angular/common'; import { Component, OnInit, inject } from '@angular/core'; import { forkJoin } from 'rxjs'; import { DashboardService, DashboardSummary } from '../../core/services/dashboard.service'; import { ResourceItem, ResourceService } from '../../core/services/resource.service'; import { Tire, TireService } from '../../core/services/tire.service'; type FleetType = 'SEMI' | 'TRACTOR'; interface FleetUnit { id: string; plate: string; brand: string | null; model: string | null; tires: Tire[]; } @Component({ selector: 'app-dashboard', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule, NgIf, NgFor, DatePipe], template: `
Dashboard

Vista general de stock y movimientos

Consulta rapidamente cuantas gomas tienes, donde estan y cuales fueron los ultimos cambios realizados.

Resumen operativo

Control diario de la flota

Monitorea disponibilidad y detecta rapido si el stock esta concentrado en deposito o distribuido en vehiculos.

{{ summary.totalTires }} gomas registradas
{{ summary.recentMovements.length }} movimientos recientes
Total de gomas {{ summary.totalTires }} Inventario consolidado
En deposito {{ summary.tiresInDeposit }} Disponibles para asignacion
En gomeria {{ summary.tiresInGomeria }} Gomas dentro de deposito Gomeria
En semis {{ summary.tiresInSemis }} Haz clic para ver unidades y gomas
En tractores {{ summary.tiresInTractors }} Haz clic para ver unidades y gomas

{{ selectedFleetType === 'SEMI' ? 'Semis y sus gomas' : 'Tractores y sus gomas' }}

{{ selectedUnits.length }} unidades
{{ selectedFleetType === 'SEMI' ? 'Semi' : 'Tractor' }}

{{ unit.plate }}

{{ unit.brand || 'Marca no informada' }} {{ unit.model ? '| ' + unit.model : '' }}

Gomas asignadas {{ unit.tires.length }}
{{ tire.code }} · {{ tire.size }}

Esta unidad no tiene gomas asignadas actualmente.

Ultimos movimientos

Tiempo real
{{ movement.tire.code }}

{{ movement.previousLocation }} -> {{ movement.newLocation }} {{ movement.newPlate ? '(' + movement.newPlate + ')' : '' }}

{{ movement.user.name }} | {{ movement.createdAt | date:'short' }}
`, }) export class DashboardComponent implements OnInit { private readonly dashboardService = inject(DashboardService); private readonly resourceService = inject(ResourceService); private readonly tireService = inject(TireService); summary: DashboardSummary | null = null; semis: ResourceItem[] = []; tractors: ResourceItem[] = []; tires: Tire[] = []; selectedFleetType: FleetType = 'SEMI'; get selectedUnits(): FleetUnit[] { const baseItems = this.selectedFleetType === 'SEMI' ? this.semis : this.tractors; return baseItems.map((item) => ({ id: item.id, plate: item.plate || 'Sin patente', brand: item.brand || null, model: item.model || null, tires: this.tires.filter((tire) => tire.currentLocation === this.selectedFleetType && tire.locationDetail.plate === item.plate), })); } ngOnInit(): void { forkJoin({ summary: this.dashboardService.getSummary(), semis: this.resourceService.getSemis(), tractors: this.resourceService.getTractors(), tires: this.tireService.getAll({}), }).subscribe(({ summary, semis, tractors, tires }) => { this.summary = summary; this.semis = semis; this.tractors = tractors; this.tires = tires; this.selectedFleetType = semis.length ? 'SEMI' : 'TRACTOR'; }); } selectFleet(type: FleetType): void { this.selectedFleetType = type; } }
